text: 据同花顺iFinD数据显示，2026年8月7日，ETF资金整体净流出265.95亿元，股票型净流出278.72亿元，宽基型净流出228.11亿元。当日ETF资金净流出榜单排名前3依次为：南方中证1000ETF（512100）净流出49.23亿元，华泰柏瑞沪深300ETF（510300）净流出27.36亿元，华夏中证1000ETF（159845）净流出23.09亿元。
text_en: According to Tonghuashun iFinD data, as of August 7, 2026, ETF funds saw a net outflow of 26.595 billion yuan overall, with equity-type funds seeing a net outflow of 27.872 billion yuan and broad-based funds seeing a net outflow of 22.811 billion yuan. The top 3 ETFs by net outflow that day were: China Southern CSI 1000 ETF (512100) with a net outflow of 4.923 billion yuan, Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF (510300) with a net outflow of 2.736 billion yuan, and ChinaAMC CSI 1000 ETF (159845) with a net outflow of 2.309 billion yuan.
